svg.text: Each value: the median of three steady 10 s windows, each window the slowest of nine load processes; a fresh cluster a point, 70 s of load.
Queen: a write is answered after the leader's fsync and one follower's; one worker per partition at a time, acks counted per message.
Kafka: RF 3, acks=all, idempotent, lz4; writes answered from the page cache (no fsync); XFS, 24/12/12 threads, writeback from 1 GB.
Streaming: a consumer group, one offset per partition. Queue mode: a share group (KIP-932), every record locked and acked; 297 consumers
(group.share.max.size raised from 200 to 300). Streaming also carried 25k partitions (p50 / p99 58 / 105 ms, 57 cores), not 50k.
